description: This file contains the definition of the 'TestLogger' class, which is a testing utility for logging. It records log entries, categorized by levels, and provides methods for verification purposes. The class extends 'AbstractLogger' from the PSR-Log package and is used for testing logging behavior.

classes.name: TestLogger
classes.description: A mock logger class for testing that records all log entries and provides methods to verify the presence, content, and matching of logs at various levels.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Records a log entry with level, message, and context, categorizing it by level for later retrieval and verification.

methods.name: hasRecords
methods.description: Checks if there are any records at a specific log level.

methods.name: hasRecord
methods.description: Verifies if a specific record with message and optional context exists at a given level.

methods.name: hasRecordThatContains
methods.description: Checks if any log message at a specified level contains a given substring.

methods.name: hasRecordThatMatches
methods.description: Checks if any log message at a specified level matches a provided regex pattern.

methods.name: hasRecordThatPasses
methods.description: General method to verify if any record at a level passes a predicate function.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls for convenience, mapping method names to specific verification methods based on log levels.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears all stored log records, resetting the logger state.
